project.name: JPMC KYC Risk Pre-Screening (UBO GraphRAG)
project.business_problem: The client was manually reviewing corporate KYC documents to extract entities, UBOs, and ownership structures, score geographic/industry/sanctions risk, and chase missing policy fields — causing slow onboarding queues, inconsistent scoring, and repetitive follow-up email drafting.
project.solution_summary: An agentic KYC pre-screening platform where analysts upload PDF/TXT/DOCX documents, Azure OpenAI extracts and validates structured KYC data against a configurable policy, computes AI risk scores with explainable reasoning, visualizes ownership graphs, generates DOCX reports, manages a prioritized client queue, and indexes documents with GraphRAG for per-project Q&A.
project.outcomes: Automated entity/UBO extraction from unstructured KYC documents; policy-gated ingestion blocking incomplete submissions; AI risk scores (0–100) with Low/Medium/High tiers and section-level reasoning; analyst queue prioritized by risk_score; downloadable KYC_Risk_Report DOCX; geographic FATF/sanctions exposure dashboard; LLM-drafted client follow-up emails; GraphRAG document Q&A per project.

agents.name: Entity Extraction Agent
agents.function_summary: Extracts entities, ownership relationships, and UBO registry records from uploaded corporate KYC documents into structured JSON for SQL persistence.
outputs: entities array (entity_name, entity_type, jurisdiction, incorporation_date, registered_address)
ubo_registry array (full_name, nationality, ownership_percentage, passport_number, linked_entities)
agents.notes: Uses JSON response_format; generates deterministic ENT/REL/UBO IDs via SHA1 when source IDs absent.

agents.name: KYC Policy Completeness Validator
agents.function_summary: Validates extracted KYC data against kyc_ingestion_policy.json required fields and blocks risk analysis when mandatory pre-KYC information is missing.
inputs: KYC ingestion policy JSON (25+ required fields)
agents.notes: Deterministic post-validation enforces policy required_if and must_be_declared rules (e.g., offshore_exposure_declaration).

agents.name: Missing Information Email Drafter
agents.function_summary: Drafts professional client-facing emails requesting missing KYC details with structured bullet lists and Compliance Team sign-off.
agents.notes: Human-in-the-loop: analyst reviews/edits draft before send via POST /riskassessment/request-more-info/send.

agents.name: Main Entity Inference Agent
agents.function_summary: Infers the primary corporate entity described in a project's latest document to center the radial ownership visualization.
agents.notes: Exposed via GET /graph/main-entity; fuzzy-matches LLM output to SQL entity names.

agents.name: ML Risk Classifier Stub
agents.function_summary: Rule-based classifier that assigns Low/Medium/High risk tier from engineered geographic, industry, ownership, PEP, and sanctions features.
agents.notes: Not a trained ML model; provides gentle prior for section score calibration in pipeline_full.py.

agents.name: Risk Scoring Agent
agents.function_summary: Aggregates geography (30), ownership (30), regulatory/sanctions (20), and industry (20) scores into a final 0–100 risk score with hard override rules for FATF blacklist, sanctions, circular ownership, and PEP exposure.
agents.model_used: Deterministic scoring + Azure OpenAI gpt-5.1 reasoning
agents.notes: Tier cutoffs: 0–33 Low, 34–66 Medium, 67–100 High; overrides force High tier.

agents.name: Risk Reasoning Generator
agents.function_summary: Generates explainable AI narratives for the final risk score and each of four risk dimensions (Geography, Ownership, Industry, Sanctions) for UI display and DOCX reports.
agents.notes: Runs 6 parallel LLM prompts; strips parentheses/brackets from output; required for risk summary payload validity.

agents.name: UBO Analysis Engine
agents.function_summary: Computes UBO-specific risk score from ownership concentration, identification transparency, structural complexity, and PEP/sanctions/geo flags.
agents.notes: Four 0–25 components: concentration, transparency, complexity, risk_flags.

agents.name: GraphRAG Index & Query Agent
agents.function_summary: Indexes per-project KYC documents into a knowledge graph with entity/community extraction and embeddings; answers analyst questions via local, global, drift, or basic search methods.
agents.model_used: Microsoft GraphRAG with Azure OpenAI gpt-5.2 + text-embedding-3-small
agents.notes: Runs as background thread after upload; exposed via POST /chat and POST /projects/{id}/index.

agents.name: KYC Risk Report Generator
agents.function_summary: Generates downloadable Word (.docx) KYC risk assessment reports with KPI summary table, section scores, UBO details, override status, and AI reasoning narratives.
inputs: entities, ubos, relationships from Azure SQL
agents.notes: Threshold bands documented in report: Low 0–30, Medium 31–55, High 56–100; served via GET /risk-assessment/report.

project.name: Affine Analytics VTO Platform
project.business_problem: Retail teams were manually compositing customer photos with multiple garment and accessory images, which was slow, inconsistent for layered looks, and did not scale with a centralized product catalog or repeatable session history.
project.solution_summary: A React operations UI and FastAPI backend that run a multi-stage virtual try-on pipeline: validate images, use Azure OpenAI GPT-4o vision to author a placement prompt, synthesize the composite with Google Gemini image generation, persist successful sessions to disk, and optionally manage an Azure Blob accessory catalog with Azure AI Vision + Azure AI Search semantic retrieval.
project.outcomes: Single-click photorealistic multi-accessory try-on from person + up to 8 product images; persisted session history with prompts and assets; catalog browse/upload with optional natural-language semantic search; operational views for adoption and pipeline health (analytics/pipeline pages currently demo/mock data).

agents.name: GPT-4o Fashion Vision Analyzer
agents.function_summary: Analyzes person and garment reference images with a fashion/computational-photography system prompt and outputs a single precise image-editing instruction for virtual try-on, including layering, lighting, and full-frame preservation.
agents.notes: Stage gpt_analysis in pipeline; temperature 0.2; UI may label model as GPT 5.4.

agents.name: Gemini Image Compositor
agents.function_summary: Synthesizes the final virtual try-on image from person photo, accessory references, and the GPT-generated editing prompt using Gemini image output modality with aspect ratio matching and up to three retries.
agents.model_used: Google Gemini (GEMINI_MODEL, e.g. gemini-3-pro-image-preview or gemini-2.0-flash-exp)
agents.notes: Stage gemini_composition; requires IMAGE response_modalities support on API tier.

agents.name: Azure AI Vision Catalog Embedder
agents.function_summary: Generates 1024-dimensional multimodal embeddings for catalog accessory images and natural-language search queries to power semantic garment discovery.
agents.model_used: Azure AI Vision retrieval APIs (vectorizeImage / vectorizeText, model-version 2023-04-15)
agents.notes: Optional; enabled when AZURE_VISION_ENDPOINT and AZURE_VISION_KEY are set.

agents.name: Azure AI Search Catalog Vector Retrieval
agents.function_summary: Maintains and queries the vto-accessories HNSW vector index for cosine-similarity ranking of catalog items from text or image-derived embeddings.
outputs: ranked catalog documents (id, blob_name, name, category, tags)
agents.model_used: Azure AI Search HNSW (cosine, 1024-d embedding field)
integrations: Azure Blob Storage (SAS URL enrichment for hits)
agents.notes: Index auto-ensured on startup; optional alongside Vision embedder; endpoint GET /api/v1/catalog/search.

project.name: Aira (CreAItive Studio)
project.business_problem: The client was manually creating Amazon PDP image sets and product videos from reference photos, product specification PDFs, and marketplace guardrails—reading long documents, writing per-slot creative briefs, running separate image tools, and reworking assets that failed marketplace compliance.
project.solution_summary: Aira is a Staples-oriented Amazon PDP creative studio: users upload references and PDFs, generate up to six role-specific images in parallel via Gemini or Azure GPT Image with optional gpt-5.4 prompt authoring, score outputs against guardrails with Gemini vision compliance, and produce Sora-2 product videos from Azure-authored scripts—with optional Azure Blob persistence for projects and sessions.
project.outcomes: Faster PDP variant production grounded in PDF spec/guardrail text, parallel multi-slot generation, quantified compliance scores (0–100) with pass/fail rule lists, and scripted Sora video output—reducing manual prompt writing and compliance rework.

agents.name: Generation Prompt Author
agents.function_summary: Azure vision+text agent that writes per-PDP-image-type multimodal prompts (or per-role directives) from reference photos and PDF excerpts before image generation.
outputs: Optional role_directives map for template fallback
agents.notes: Controlled by GEMINI_PROMPT_AUTHOR env (legacy name). Falls back to PromptGenerator templates if Azure call fails.

agents.name: PDP Image Generator (Gemini)
agents.function_summary: Generates Amazon-style PDP PNGs from reference images plus authored prompts, one variant per parallel task.
agents.notes: Default provider; supports model override via multipart model field.

agents.name: PDP Image Generator (Azure GPT Image)
agents.function_summary: Azure images/edits endpoint generates PDP variants from first reference image and per-slot prompt.
outputs: PNG per variant via Azure base64 response
agents.notes: Speed mode fast|quality via AZURE_OPENAI_IMAGE_SPEED_MODE.

agents.name: PDP Compliance Checker
agents.function_summary: Vision LLM scores a generated PDP image against guardrails-only excerpts and returns pass/fail rules, warnings, suggestions, and compliance_score 0-100.
agents.notes: Product spec PDF required on upload but explicitly excluded from compliance model context.

agents.name: Amazon PDP Video Prompt Author
agents.function_summary: Produces a full Amazon PDP video ad script (reference block, compliance checklist, scenes, generation prompts) from product spec, guardrails, optional user script, and reference image.
tech_stack: In-repo Amazon PDP video master template
agents.notes: Human approves prompt in Editor before Sora render; can skip LLM if approved_prompt supplied.

agents.name: Sora Image-to-Video Generator
agents.function_summary: Submits image-to-video jobs to Azure Sora, polls until complete, returns MP4 for PDP video ads.
agents.notes: Requires AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, API key, and video deployment configured.

project.name: Merchandising Vision Agent
project.business_problem: The client was manually auditing retail shelf and planogram photos—counting brand facings, reading shelf-rail prices, and identifying out-of-stock gaps—which was slow and did not scale across large image libraries stored in Azure Blob.
project.solution_summary: An agentic shelf-vision system that runs Roboflow row and product detection on upload, caches artifacts to Azure Blob, indexes images for semantic search, and answers natural-language merchandising questions via parallel Azure OpenAI row analyzers consolidated into a final answer—with Streamlit UI and FastAPI endpoints.
project.outcomes: Automated shelf row segmentation, per-row product detection, semantic image discovery with GPT-filtered relevance, and NL Q&A for counts, pricing (e.g. Twix $1.45 / 99¢), and stock-out detection (e.g. Mars bars, Wispa tray empty) with reasoning and latency metrics.

agents.name: Semantic Image Search & Validator
agents.function_summary: Embeds text queries with Azure AI Vision, retrieves similar shelf images from Azure AI Search, and filters results with GPT vision relevance scoring.
agents.model_used: Azure AI Vision (vectorizeText) + Azure AI Search HNSW + Azure OpenAI gpt-5.2
agents.notes: top_k=10 retrieval; GPT validation parallelized; on error includes image by default

agents.name: Roboflow Shelf Row Detector
agents.function_summary: Detects shelf rows as polygons, produces masked row crops and a polygon-overlay summary image.
agents.notes: ROW_CONFIDENCE=40; rail_margin_ratio=0.22 for price-tag area

agents.name: Roboflow Product Detector
agents.function_summary: Runs YOLO product detection on each shelf row crop and writes annotated images with per-class counts.
agents.notes: Parallel ThreadPoolExecutor up to 6 workers; class label often generic 'object'

agents.name: Shelf Count Agent
agents.function_summary: Per-row brand-aware product counting from YOLO-annotated shelf images with confidence and structured visual reasoning.
agents.notes: Invoked when query matches count keywords; runs in parallel with generic agent

agents.name: Shelf Understanding Agent
agents.function_summary: Answers descriptive, price, promotion, and stock-out questions from cropped row images and full shelf context.
inputs: Optional original shelf image for price/promo queries
agents.notes: Price/promo path uses is_price_or_promo_query() and full image plus all row crops

agents.name: Final Answer Consolidation Agent
agents.function_summary: Consolidates count and generic row-level analyses into a single natural-language answer based on task_type routing.
inputs: intermediate JSON with count_analysis and generic_analysis
agents.notes: Text-only call; sums product_count across rows for total queries

agents.name: GPT Image Relevance Validator
agents.function_summary: Strict vision-based filter that approves or rejects blob images against a user's semantic search query.
agents.notes: Uses detail:low for cost/latency; max 8-10 parallel workers

project.name: Mars Sales Genie (Copilot) / Unified View
project.business_problem: Field and HQ teams manually reconciled shelf photos, planogram compliance, Mars sales spreadsheets, and retail policy documents across disconnected tools, causing slow KPI reporting and inconsistent answers about on-shelf execution versus policy and sales data.
project.solution_summary: Unified retail copilot and dashboard: React field-executive UI plus FastAPI backend that uploads shelf images to Azure Blob, runs Roboflow/YOLO and Azure OpenAI vision, persists KPIs to Azure SQL, indexes content in Azure AI Search, and answers questions via AutoGen-orchestrated Quin (SQL) and Eryl (semantic RAG) agents with optional vision enrichment and compliance/competitive scoring.
project.outcomes: Single interface for shelf vision KPIs, policy-aware Q&A, sales SQL analytics, route prioritization by OOS/compliance risk, planogram semantic search, and promo/order simulation—reducing manual audit reconciliation time and standardizing Mars field execution insights.

agents.name: Pipeline Intent Classifier
agents.function_summary: Classifies each user question into vision_only, vision_then_unified, or unified_only and flags multi-shelf comparisons for SQL-only routing.
agents.notes: Implemented in backend/unified_intent.py; runs before planogram_bridge and Unified_Mdb.

agents.name: Quin SQL Agent Chain
agents.function_summary: AutoGen multi-agent chain that generates, executes, and critiques SQL Server queries on mars schema tables (Mars_Sales_Data, shelf_visit, retail_planogram_stocks, etc.) and returns structured sales/inventory insights.
agents.notes: Agents: routing_agent, Sql_Generator, Sql_Executor, Sql_tool, Sql_Execution_Critic, Insight_Generator in Unified_Mdb.py.

agents.name: Eryl Semantic RAG Agent Chain
agents.function_summary: Retrieves and answers from indexed retail policy and unstructured documents (Chocolate_Confectionery_Retail_Policy.docx, emails, guidelines) using Azure AI Search vector + semantic retrieval.
agents.notes: Agents: query_transformer, Selector_agent, retriever, llm_answer_maker, critic_agent.

agents.name: Planogram Vision LLM Suite
agents.function_summary: Azure OpenAI vision functions for shelf-level product extraction, row counting, generic row description, daily KPI JSON, and final natural-language shelf answers after Roboflow cropping.
agents.notes: backend/planogram_agentic/llm_functions.py — count_function, generic_function, final_answer_function, shelf_levels, daily_kpi.

agents.name: Shelf Layout Compliance Vision Agent
agents.function_summary: Compares actual shelf photos against layout and agreement references; emits compliance rows and issues; deterministic scoring for placement, facings, pricing, layout match, and document clauses.
agents.model_used: Azure OpenAI gpt-5.2 vision + deterministic compliance_scoring.py
agents.notes: POST /api/planogram/shelf-compliance and related complete-report endpoints.

agents.name: Competitive Shelf Intelligence Scorer
agents.function_summary: Computes Mars visibility, competitor pressure, promo and shelf position scores from vision-extracted brand facings using weighted shelf-level rules.
inputs: vision shelf rows with brand, facings, shelf_level
agents.notes: backend/competitive_scoring.py; POST /api/competitive/analyze.

agents.name: Final Answer Rewriter
agents.function_summary: Post-processes combined vision+SQL+semantic draft answers into concise structured user-facing text without adding new facts.
agents.notes: Toggle via UNIFIED_ENABLE_FINAL_REWRITE env in Unified_Mdb.py.

agents.name: Roboflow Shelf Row Detector
agents.function_summary: Segments shelf rows and detects product bounding boxes; writes cropped and annotated artifacts to Azure Blob for downstream vision LLMs.
agents.model_used: Roboflow YOLO (row project v4, product project v3)
agents.notes: planogram_agentic/detect_crop.py; triggered on upload via planogram_upload.py.

agents.name: Mars Sales Order Simulator
agents.function_summary: CatBoost/sklearn regression predicts demand and realized sales under promotion, price, and stock constraints for Snickers/Mars/Twix SKUs.
agents.notes: Trained from Soft_Drinks_Sales_Q1_2026.xlsx; POST /api/simulator/run.

agents.name: Executive Action Card Writer
agents.function_summary: Generates short action-oriented title and subtitle text for field executive promo, compliance, and recommended action cards.
inputs: action dict with store and KPI flags
agents.notes: app/services/llm_action_text_service.py; enrich_actions_with_llm.

agents.name: Planogram Image Semantic Search
agents.function_summary: Embeds shelf images with Azure AI Vision, vector-searches Azure AI Search by supermarket, and validates matches with GPT before returning blob hits.
agents.model_used: Azure AI Vision embeddings + Azure OpenAI gpt-5.2 validation
agents.notes: POST /api/planogram/semantic-search; index image_embeddings_index.
